features.description: aragora mission {seed,run,status,resume} CLI: seed from a goal (via nomic/task_decomposer + meta_planner), run the orchestrator, show progress. Proving ground: run a tiny real mission (land the misc-2 cleanup PRs) on it.
Validation contract: VAL-* assertion schema + validation-state.json + feature.fulfills mapping (already a field on Feature). Coverage invariant: every assertion fulfilled by >=1 feature.

On milestone_complete, auto-inject a scrutiny validator feature (lint/typecheck/test + per-feature review via aragora/evaluation LLM-judge) and a user-testing validator feature (assertion verification). Milestone seals only when its assertions pass.
Mission library surface on knowledge/mound: workers read merge-gate / environment / gotchas each run and write learnings back; append-only operator-approvals ledger.

Fork->escalate->record->resume: blocked features surface ONE structured question via control_plane/notifications + approvals, record in the ledger, resume. Hard rule: never loop on an operator-gated blocker.
Per-role model binding via aragora/routing: orchestrator=flagship, worker=cheap-or-flagship per tier, validator=cross-family.

THE walk-away unlock: run orchestrator + workers on API keys via config/secrets (AWS Secrets Manager), headless on EC2 -- NOT subscription CLIs. Removes the 402 ceiling + single-account contention class. Relay-with-timeout instead of hard-halt.
expected_behavior: launch a mission, close the laptop, it runs for days
only pings the operator at genuine forks

features.description: Every feature ships its merge-quorum result as a signed decision receipt (gauntlet/receipts + review_queue already produce these). Mission scorecard: N features, each adversarially vetted + receipted.
Position as 'autonomous engineering where every change is debate-gated and receipted' (Factory-with-provenance). Dogfood: Aragora governs Aragora's own development = the demo.

Shared 'pheromone' environment for a dispatcher-free worker swarm. DONE: aragora/missions/ledger.py (file-locked atomic claims/leases + evaporation + constraint/park memory + select_for). 10 tests + scripts/mission_swarm_demo.py (PASS: 3 worker processes self-partitioned 9 units, zero collisions, no dispatcher). Encodes the research synthesis: stigmergy/ACO (claims), response-threshold division of labor (select_for), Reflexion-as-data (constraints are environment state, NOT self-edited prompts).

Pheromone wired to the gate (CONTRACT). DONE: aragora/missions/swarm.py (run_worker: select via ledger -> run gate dispatch -> record_done on success, park constraint after park_threshold blocks; converges, no unbounded retry). select_for reads done/parks; the dispatch (BossLoopDispatch) stays the hard selector. 4 tests incl. treadmill-escape (a persistent blocker is parked after N attempts and the swarm finishes the rest -- the anti-treadmill a stateless prompt loop cannot keep). REMAINING (via a5): swap the fake gate for the LIVE boss_loop/review_queue binding.

Bounded, measured experiment: N cheap workers picking units via the ledger (lease + novelty pressure) + merge-quorum gate as selector, vs the single orchestrator, on the same backlog. Measure throughput-per-token + contention-resistance. Hypothesis: swarm wins on exploration breadth + contention-resistance; gate remains non-negotiable for correctness; the ledger design (not the prompts) is what makes or breaks it.
